_comment: assets/feeds/<handle>.json — the 'static' source shape. Replace every value below with real data from the account. Do not ship this file with placeholder URLs; the grid will render a skeleton instead of a broken tile, but an empty feed reads better than a fake one.
_refresh: Regenerate on a cron (Vercel cron → api/instagram.js → write to blob/repo) or paste manually once a week.

data.caption: Short caption, trimmed to ~120 chars for the alt text.

_field_notes.media_type: IMAGE | VIDEO | CAROUSEL_ALBUM — drives the corner badge only
_field_notes.thumbnail_url: Instagram CDN URLs expire. For the static path, self-host the thumbnails in assets/feeds/img/ so the grid does not rot.
_field_notes.permalink: Opens in a new tab. Required — a tile with no destination is dead weight.
_field_notes.caption: Used as alt text and aria-label. Keep it descriptive, not hashtags.
